Don't let the media hype frighten you into getting a shot for flu. You don't need it if you are even halfway healthy, and probably you don't need it if you are sick, either. The flu is not a fatal disease, except in a small number of cases where those who catch it have some other condition. For example, if you have severe breathing problems, the flu may kill you -- but it isn't really the flu killing you, it's your breathing problems. Think of the flu as a really bad cold, which is just about what it is. And don't pump your body full of things that will weaken your natural immune system or otherwise cause problems worse than the flu itself.
